_: Only `title` is shown in the game (applyArcText); `emotionalNote` lands on def.note and is not displayed. Canon: docs/STORY-LEDGER.md (28 Sept 2026) and docs/STORY-REBUILD.md. Tom owns the Ranger from the start (a gift from his father, who did not live at 299 Fraser). Margaret is his mother and never rides with the gang.

arc.title: Le Ranger rend service
arc.what: RETIRED in the restructure (29 Sept 2026): never offered; kept for old saves. Tom already owns the 1993 Ford Ranger, a gift from his father, and pays for its gas and most of its parts. His mother asks for a favour (the mower to the church), and the summer opens at the dep and the marina with the gang.
arc.where: 299 Chemin Fraser driveway; Saint-Paul; the Dépanneur Palmyra; the Aylmer marina
arc.playerDoes: A first run of favours with his own truck, then down to the marina to meet everyone.

arc.title: La Saint-Jean
arc.what: Main mission 3. The Saint-Jean at the beach, with Aylmer's big bonfire (very real, Tom 28 Sept); what happens at it is the game's. The summer starts on 22 June so the night of the 24th is in it; played later, the job is 'Le feu à la plage' and does not claim the date.
arc.where: The Galeries d'Aylmer lot; Plage des Cèdres; 75 Denise-Friend
arc.playerDoes: Hauls fragile speakers to the beach without breaking them, picks up Sayyad and Zahra, and parks by the fire at dusk.
arc.emotionalNote: The whole town in one place. Peak belonging.

arc.title: La dernière veillée
arc.what: RETIRED in the restructure (29 Sept 2026): never offered; kept for old saves. OPEN DECISION (docs/STORY-REBUILD.md). One truck, three bridges, no reason, Parliament across the water. Nobody leaving and no letters: those did not happen.
arc.where: The Champlain, the Chaudière and the Alexandra
arc.playerDoes: Drives the gang over three bridges with no clock.
arc.emotionalNote: Nobody says anything for a while.

arc.title: Le dernier soir
arc.what: Finale. Labour Day night, untimed. Each main mission's place holds one small callback (the couch still in the tree); friends are where they would be, one line each, and nobody says goodbye. The landline rings at 299 Fraser: Dad, excited, 'So? Ottawa or McGill?'. On the kitchen table, next to Tom's Heritage nanotech project, a University of Waterloo brochure: a new program, Nanotechnology Engineering (timing a composite). Tom picks it up.
arc.playerDoes: A free drive with no timer, no police and no rivals; answers the phone; picks up the brochure.
arc.emotionalNote: The more you love it, the more you have to leave.
